the moment as well as the first stage gives \(\widehat\delta_0=0.984, 0.829, 0.740\).
\(\Delta_{\mathbf V}\) is \eqref{eq:ols_fgls_gap} evaluated at
\(\widehat\delta_0\) with the same variance model (Remark~\ref{rem:delta_W}).
